acceptance.given: A fixture package is inspected without a quality sidecar using the validator's explicit inventory or strict mode.

forbidden: A missing quality sidecar is silently reported as 'pass'.
oracle.observable: Structured validator result for the sidecar-less fixture, including status and diagnostic classification.

acceptance.when: During execution of the migration fixture validation case against the real validator entry point.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_migration.py::test_a22 must fail when a fixture without a quality sidecar is classified as pass or lacks an explicit non-pass classification.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure sidecar-less fixture inspection yields an explicit non-pass classification and migration coverage verifies that behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Fixture state changes from having no quality sidecar to an inspected result that is explicitly classified as legacy/rejected/non-pass rather than pass.
